habitat.title: Turning off the fans may not put the fire out
habitat.text: Stopping ventilation starves a microgravity flame. In still air at this atmosphere a gas flame is predicted to burn a median 25 s (Earth cabin air: 5 s), and 41% are still burning after 30 s (Earth cabin air: 0%).
habitat.action: Plan to isolate and extinguish, not only to cut the airflow.
habitat.source: ACME CFI-G (PSI-159) survival model; ACME BRE (PSI-20) reports the same
habitat.caveat: Interpolated: no CFI-G tests between 24 % and 33 % O₂.

habitat.title: Common cabin materials still burn
habitat.text: 5 real solid burns lie within ±5 % O₂ and ±0.2 atm of this atmosphere: cotton, fabric (SIBAL), PMMA kept burning; Nomex did not.
habitat.action: Screen habitat materials at the habitat atmosphere, not only in Earth air.
habitat.source: Saffire IV-VI (NASA NTRS 20240002981), BASS, BASS-II, Saffire I-III

habitat.title: A burning plastic poisons the cabin air
habitat.text: On Cygnus, burning acrylic (PMMA) raised CO₂ by 8,117-8,539 ppm and CO by 308-320 ppm, against 1,390-2,800 ppm CO₂ for fabric.
habitat.action: Size air scrubbing and crew masks for plastic fires, not only for fabric.

habitat.title: Spilled liquid fuel burns faster
habitat.text: A 3 mm methanol droplet is predicted to burn at 0.65 mm²/s here, against 0.50 mm²/s in Earth cabin air. CO₂ and helium suppression was only ever tested up to 25 % O₂.
habitat.action: Validate suppressant amounts at the habitat oxygen level before relying on them.

habitat.title: Fire spreads faster in tight spaces
habitat.text: The same fabric, in nearly the same air and air speed, spread almost three times faster in a 7.6 cm duct than in a 51 cm one.
habitat.action: Treat racks, ducts and stowage gaps as higher-risk zones.
habitat.source: Saffire I-IV and BASS; Olson et al., Table 1

habitat.title: Smoke detectors are untested in this air
habitat.text: 0 of 555 smoke and soot tests (SAME, SAME-R, SPICE) were run within ±5 % O₂ and ±0.2 atm of this atmosphere; all of them used 21 % O₂ at 1 atm.
habitat.action: Test detector response to smoke made in the habitat atmosphere.
